import sys
MOD = 10**9 + 7

def main():
    sys.setrecursionlimit(1 << 25)
    n, D = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())
    adj = [[] for _ in range(n+1)]
    for i in range(2, n+1):
        p = int(sys.stdin.readline())
        adj[p].append(i)

    dp = [[0]*(D+2) for _ in range(n+2)]
    for d in range(1, D+1):
        dp[1][d] = 1

    def dfs(u):
        for v in adj[u]:
            dfs(v)
            for d in range(1, D+1):
                dp[u][d] = (dp[u][d] + dp[v][d]) % MOD
                if d > 1:
                    dp[u][d] = (dp[u][d] + dp[v][d-1]) % MOD

    dfs(1)
    res = sum(dp[1][d] for d in range(1, D+1)) % MOD
    print(res)

main()
